build_MSPNHead: build a Multi-stage multi-unit heatmap head for pose estimation with configurable stages and units
create_PRM: create a Pose Refine Machine module to refine input heatmaps using global and local paths
create_PredictHeatmap: create a PredictHeatmap module to predict heatmaps from input feature maps with optional PRM refinement
test_MSPNHead_forward: test the MSPNHead forward pass with multi-stage multi-unit feature maps and verify output heatmaps
review_MSPNHead_loss: review the MSPNHead loss method to calculate multi-stage multi-unit keypoint losses and pose accuracy
